label: Protections missing
means: Guards that are off: rules with no bypass, fixed tags, a push rule on secret file names, deploys from named branches.
goal_source: GitHub docs, About rulesets (bypass lists), Available rules for rulesets (Restrict updates, Restrict deletions, Restrict file paths) and Deployments and environments (deployment branches and tags), read 2026-11-10; goal: none missing
source: state: gh api rulesets and each active one (bypass_actors, tag rules deletion and update, push rule file_path_restriction against params.blocked_paths), branches/{branch}/protection (enforce_admins), tags (the first listed), environments (deployment_branch_policy); a row with nothing to guard is left out

params.comment: repo: owner/name, else GITHUB_REPOSITORY. blocked_paths: the file names a push ruleset must restrict, exactly as the rule lists them; a repo that tracks one of these names its own list. expected: the General settings this repo holds itself to, as fields of gh api repos/{repo} and their values; empty means the repo names none and settings.general_drift is not measured. included_cache_gb: the Actions cache size a repo gets with its plan.

label: General settings off standard
means: Settings on the General page that differ from the values this repo names as its standard.
goal_source: template goal: a repo names the General settings it holds itself to and none drifts; GitHub docs, REST API endpoints for repositories, Get a repository, lists the fields (read 2026-11-10)
source: state: gh api repos/{repo}, each field named in params.expected against its value there

label: Outside access
means: People outside the organization who can reach the repo, plus invitations not yet accepted.
goal_source: template goal: access comes through organization membership, so no one holds it from outside and no invitation stays open; a repo with outside collaborators sets its own goal
source: state: gh api repos/{repo}/collaborators?affiliation=outside and repos/{repo}/invitations, counted

label: Secrets no workflow reads
means: Stored Actions secrets whose name no workflow file uses; each is a credential kept for nothing.
goal_source: GitHub docs, Secure use reference, Audit and rotate registered secrets (read 2026-11-10): review the registered secrets and remove those no longer needed
source: state: gh api repos/{repo}/actions/secrets and each environment's secrets (names only), against secrets.NAME in .github/workflows/*.yml of the checkout

label: Rules that wait for a person
means: Merge and deploy rules that need a person's approval or a timer before work can land.
goal_source: template goal: no person reviews, so a rule that waits for one stops every merge or deploy; a repo with human reviewers drops this metric. GitHub docs, Available rules for rulesets and Deployments and environments, name the rules (read 2026-11-10)
source: state: pull_request rules of the active rulesets on the default branch and of its classic protection (approvals, code owner review, last-push approval, required reviewers), and each environment's protection_rules (required_reviewers, wait_timer)

label: Settings that bill past the plan
means: Settings switched on that add charges beyond what the plan includes.
goal_source: GitHub docs, GitHub Actions billing (read 2026-11-10): cache storage past the included 10 GB a repo is billed; GitHub changelog, 2026-04-27: Copilot code review on a private repo uses Actions minutes from 2026-06-01; goal: none on unless bought
source: state: gh api repos/{repo}/actions/cache/storage-limit (max_cache_size_gb against params.included_cache_gb) and the active rulesets' copilot_code_review rules; not measured for a public repo

label: Open-repo settings off
means: Settings a public repo needs before outside contributors arrive: approval for every outside contributor's run, private vulnerability reporting, push protection and Discussions.
goal_source: template goal: each is one API call and protects the repo from outside code or a public leak; GitHub docs, Approving workflow runs from forks, Configuring private vulnerability reporting, About push protection and Enabling GitHub Discussions (read 2026-11-12)
source: state: gh api repos/{repo} (has_discussions, security_and_analysis.secret_scanning_push_protection), repos/{repo}/actions/permissions/fork-pr-contributor-approval (approval_policy) and repos/{repo}/private-vulnerability-reporting (enabled); not measured for a private repo

label: Age of the admin readings
means: Hours since a signed-in run last read the settings an automatic run cannot; an old reading can hide a changed setting.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a setting changed today shows on the page by tomorrow, so the signed-in run that reads these settings is at most a day old
source: state: generated_at of local.json in the repo's data folder, the last collect.mjs --local run, against the time of this CI run
